nodes.label: Live Provider Tests
nodes.rationale: The only tests that touch the network, marked provider and deselected by default so CI never depends on a third party's uptime or quota. They are deliberately shallow and assert nothing about values, because the market decides those and a test that fails when the market is closed is a test nobody will trust. Without credentials they skip with a message: a skipped test is honest, a silently passing one is not.

nodes.label: Recording a Replay Fixture (capture_stream)
nodes.rationale: Capture a real session once and commit it so everyone else can replay it forever without credentials.

edges.source_location: opposite halves of the same provider-trust problem
